user.title: Hue-Lite
user.description:
Hue-style scenes, a Natural light scene that follows the sun, and wake-up, evening and coming-home routines for your lights.

Lights take part through labels: Evening, Wake up, Nightlight, Coming home and Exclude from lighting. Hue-Lite uses the ones you already have and creates the rest.

data_description.presence: The zone whose number of people decides coming home, leaving home and whether the evening routine starts.
data_description.dimmers: Let Hue Dimmer Switches (RWL02x) paired with ZHA control the lights in their area.

create_entry.default:
Give your lights an area and the labels of the routines they should join. For the Lights dashboard, add a dashboard (Settings → Dashboards → Add dashboard → New dashboard from scratch), open it, choose Edit dashboard → ⋮ → Raw configuration editor, and replace everything with:

strategy:
  type: custom:hue-lite

Reload the browser first so it has Hue-Lite's dashboard.

init.title: Hue-Lite options
init.description: Which label puts a light into each routine. A label counts on the light, its device or its area. Lights without a routine label still take part in scenes from the dashboard, and in their area's dimmer.

data_description.label_evening: Lights the evening routine takes: on before sunset, through the scenes, off at bedtime.
data_description.label_wake_up: Lights that fade up at the wake-up time.
data_description.label_nightlight: Lights that get Nightlight instead of Rest overnight (Natural light) and before bed (evening routine).
data_description.label_coming_home: Lights that come on in Natural light (or back in the evening routine, if it has them) when someone arrives home.
data_description.label_exclude: Lights left out of everything (the dashboard, scenes, routines and dimmers) when they, their device or their area has this label. Hidden lights are left out too.
data_description.presence: The zone whose number of people decides coming home, leaving home and whether the evening routine starts.
data_description.dimmers: Let Hue Dimmer Switches (RWL02x) paired with ZHA control the lights in their area.

apply_preset.name: Apply preset
apply_preset.description: Sets lights to a Hue-style preset or colour scene (Golden hour, Nebula, Aurora: their colours are spread across the colour bulbs and drift slowly), taking them out of the Natural light scene, the evening routine and Auto. With no target, every light.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The preset or colour scene to apply.

natural_light.name: Natural light
natural_light.description: Puts lights into the Natural light scene (taking them off Auto): they turn on and follow the sun until another scene is picked or they're changed by hand. With no target, every light.

follow.name: Follow natural light
follow.description: Turn off to take the lights out of the scene instead.

next_scene.name: Next scene
next_scene.description: Moves lights to the next scene, like pressing a Hue dimmer's On button again: Natural light, Energize, Cool bright, Read, Relax, Rest, Nightlight, and round. Lights that are off come on in Natural light.

set_auto.name: Set Auto
set_auto.description: Puts lights on Auto, or takes them off it. On Auto, a light leaves its scene and straight away does what the routines ask (wake up, the evening routine) whether or not it has their labels, on with whichever is running and off if neither is, until a scene is picked for it or it's changed. Off Auto, it leaves the routine holding it now; labelled lights are taken again next time. With no target, every light.

auto.name: Auto
auto.description: On to follow the routines, off to leave them.

missing_label.title: Hue-Lite's {role} label was deleted
missing_label.description: Hue-Lite chooses its {role} lights by a label that no longer exists, so {role} has no lights. Open **Settings → Devices & services → Hue-Lite → Configure** and pick a label for it.
